name: Create Basic Chart
description: Step-by-step state machine for creating a chart from tabular data in Microsoft Excel.

states.name: Spreadsheet Active
states.description: Excel window active with numeric and label data entered in sheet cells
states.instruction: Select the data cells you want to chart by dragging across them.

verification.condition: Multiple cell selection active or Quick Analysis button visible

states.name: Data Range Selected
states.description: Cells highlighted, ready for ribbon chart insertion
states.instruction: Click the 'Insert' tab in the top Excel ribbon.

verification.condition: Insert ribbon tab becomes active and command band updates

states.name: Insert Ribbon Active
states.description: Charts command group visible on the ribbon
states.instruction: Click 'Recommended Charts' (or choose a column chart icon).

verification.condition: Insert Chart dialog opens or chart object is placed on sheet

states.name: Chart Inserted
states.description: Chart canvas object rendered on the active worksheet
states.instruction: Your chart is created! Click to select or customize it.

verification.condition: Chart Design / Format contextual tabs visible
